verdict.rationale: Sentry documents no dedicated sandbox or test environment. Two workarounds exist: you can run a fully separate self-hosted instance for free, and you can scope the MCP server to a specific org or project so an agent stays inside a non-production project. Neither is presented as a sandbox for safe testing. Missing for 10: a documented first-party sandbox or test-org feature, test or fake data isolation guidance for agents, a read-only or dry-run mode, and independent corroboration that agents can safely test without touching production data.
